safi-cedvel:1-2.t:
* I'rab:
(تنزيل) a nominative mubtadaʾ (subject); (من الله) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.
The clause «تنزيل الكتاب من الله ...» has no grammatical position: inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya).

safi-cedvel:3-5.t:
* I'rab:
(في السموات) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of إنّ; (اللام) for emphasis; (للمؤمنين) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of آيات.
The clause «إنّ في السموات ... لآيات» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
4- (الواو) conjunction in both places; (في خلقكم) attached to a fronted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (آيات); (ما) a relative noun in the position of genitive, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to خلقكم with a muḍāf implied, i.e. the creation of what He disperses; (من دابة) a tamyīz (specification) of ما — or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied resumptive pronoun —; (لقوم) attached to a naʿt of آيات ...
The clause «في خلقكم ... آيات» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يبثّ ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «يوقنون» is in the position of genitive as naʿt of قوم.
5- (الواو) conjunction in all four places; (اختلاف) genitive by an omitted preposition indicated by the preceding preposition (في), attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ آيات [Note: Or conjoined to خلقكم.. and likewise آيات is conjoined to the first آيات, and there is no new clause in the speech.]; (ما) a relative noun in the position of genitive, conjoined to اختلاف by the wāw; (من السماء) attached to (أنزل); (من رزق) attached to (أنزل) [Note: The first (من) is for the beginning of the extent (ibtidāʾ al-ghāya) and the second (من) is explicative (bayān), so it may validly be attached to a ḥāl of the implied resumptive pronoun.]; (الفاء) conjunction; (به) attached to (أحيا); (بعد) an accusative adverb (ẓarf), attached to (أحيا); conjoined to اختلاف, genitive [Translator's note: this phrase stands detached in the source, apparently referring to تصريف الرياح.]; (لقوم) attached to a naʿt of آيات.
The clause «(في) اختلاف الليل ... آيات» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause في خلقكم ... آيات.
The clause «أنزل الله ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second relative noun (ما).
The clause «أحيا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أنزل.
The clause «يعقلون» is in the position of genitive as naʿt of the (second) قوم.

safi-cedvel:6-6.t:
* I'rab:
(تلك) a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is the clause نتلوها [Note: The khabar may be (آيات), and the clause نتلوها a second khabar or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of آيات, the governing factor in it being the demonstrative, by analogy with the words of Allah the Exalted: «وتلك بيوتهم خاوية» with خاوية in the accusative.]; (عليك) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نتلوها); (بالحقّ) attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of نتلو or of its object; (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; (بأيّ) attached to (يؤمنون), and the interrogative carries the sense of denial; (بعد) an accusative adverb (ẓarf), attached to (يؤمنون) with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. after the discourse of Allah.
The clause «تلك آيات الله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «نتلوها ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ تلك.
The clause «يؤمنون» is in the position of jussive as apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if they do not believe in this discourse, then in what discourse will they believe?

safi-cedvel:7-10.t:
* I'rab:
(ويل) a nominative mubtadaʾ (subject) [Note: Beginning with an indefinite noun was permitted because the word indicates blame.]; (لكلّ) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) ...
The clause «ويل لكلّ أفّاك ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
8- (عليه) attached to (تتلى); (كأن) lightened from the heavy form (mukhaffafa), its noun being the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); (الفاء) conjunctive, linking the effect to the cause; (بعذاب) attached to (بشره).
The clause «يسمع ...» is in the position of genitive as a second naʿt (adjective) of أفّاك.
The clause «تتلى ...» is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of آيات.
The clause «يصرّ ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause يسمع.
The clause «كأن لم يسمعها» is in the position of accusative as ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of يصرّ.
The clause «لم يسمعها» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the lightened كأن.
The clause «بشّره» has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e.: take heed, and give him tidings.
9- (الواو) conjunction; (من آياتنا) attached to a ḥāl of (شيئا); (هزوا) a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), governed by اتّخذ; (لهم) attached to an omitted fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (عذاب).
The clause «علم ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «اتّخذها ...» has no grammatical position: apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «أولئك لهم عذاب» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «لهم عذاب» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
10- (من ورائهم) attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ جهنم; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) negative; (عنهم) attached to (يغني); (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle in both places; (شيئا) object of يغني [Note: Or a relative noun in both, in the position of nominative, the resumptive pronoun being omitted in both. — A mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, i.e. any of availing, the mafʿūl bihi being implied.] [Translator's note: the footnote in the source appears to combine two separate notes, one on (ما) and one on (شيئا).]; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) redundant (zāʾida), to reinforce the negation.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كسبوا) is in the position of nominative as fāʿil of يغني, and the interpreted maṣdar (ما اتّخذوا) is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the first maṣdar; (من دون) attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi governed by اتّخذوا; (الواو) conjunction; (لهم عذاب عظيم) like لهم عذاب مهين (in the previous verse).
The clause «من ورائهم جهنّم» is in the position of nominative as badal (substitute) of (لهم عذاب ...).
The clause «لا يغني عنهم ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause لهم عذاب.
The clause «كسبوا ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the first particle-relative (ما).
The clause «اتّخذوا ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second particle-relative (ما).
The clause «لهم عذاب ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the first clause لهم عذاب.

* Rhetoric:
Al-taḍādd (a word bearing opposite meanings): in the words of Allah the Exalted «مِنْ وَرائِهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ».
Al-taḍādd is the use of a word that admits a meaning and its opposite, being shared between the two meanings, so that it is used for a thing and its opposite.
In this noble verse the figure of taḍādd is found, because the meaning is either "in front of them", since they are heading towards what has been prepared for them, or "behind them", since they are turning away from that and devoting themselves to this world; for وراء is a name for the direction that a person conceals, whether behind or in front.

* Benefits:
- The lightened كأن.
In this verse occur the words of Allah the Exalted كَأَنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعْها. (كأن) is lightened from the heavy form and has governed like إنّ: its noun is the pronoun of the matter, and the clause (لم يسمعها) is in the position of nominative as khabar of كأن. The implied form is (كأنه لم يسمعها). However, its noun may be present and its khabar a single word. The following verse was narrated:
ويوما توافينا بوجه مقسم ... كأن ظبية تعطو إلى وارق السلم
(And one day she meets us with a lovely face, as though a gazelle stretching towards a leafy salam tree.)
with (ظبية) in the accusative as the noun of كأن, the clause after it being an adjective of it and the khabar omitted, the implied form being: as though a stretching gazelle were this woman — by reversed simile, which is more eloquent; with (ظبية) in the nominative as the khabar, the clause after it being an adjective and its noun being the omitted pronoun of the matter, the implied form being (كأنها ظبية); and with (ظبية) in the genitive on the view that أن is redundant between the kāf and its genitive noun, the implied form being (كظبية).
When its noun is omitted and its khabar is a nominal clause, it needs no separator, as in the saying of the poet:
ووجه مشرق اللون ... كأن ثدياه حقان
(And a face of radiant colour, as though her breasts were two small round boxes.)
The point of evidence is his saying (كأن ثدياه حقان), where the noun of كأن is the pronoun of the matter, and the clause (ثدياه حقان), made of a mubtadaʾ and khabar, is in the position of nominative as the khabar of كأن, the implied form being (كأنه ثدياه حقان). Therefore there is no separation between كأن and its khabar that is a clause.
But if the khabar is a verbal clause, it is separated by (قد), as in his saying:
لا يهولنّك اصطلاء لظى الحر ... ب فمحذورها كأن قد ألما
(Let not the warming at the blaze of war frighten you, for what is feared of it is as though it had already struck.)
The point of evidence is his saying (كأن قد ألما), where the khabar of كأن is a verbal clause, so it is separated from (كأن) by قد.
Or the separator is (لم), as in the words of Allah the Exalted (كأن لم تغن بالأمس), and the words of Allah the Exalted occurring in the verse under discussion (كأن لم يسمعها).

safi-cedvel:11-11.t:
* I'rab:
(بآيات) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كفروا); (لهم عذاب) like the previous one [Note: In verse (9) of the sūra.]; (من رجز) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (عذاب) ...
The clause «هذا هدى ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «الذين كفروا لهم عذاب» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause.
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لهم عذاب ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (الذين).

safi-cedvel:12-13.t:
* I'rab:
(لكم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (سخّر); (اللام) for giving the reason (taʿlīl); (تجري) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām; (فيه) attached to (تجري); (بأمره) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الفلك ...
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تجري ...) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (سخّر); (الواو) conjunction; (لتبتغوا) like لتجري; (من فضله) attached to (تبتغوا). The interpreted maṣdar (لتبتغوا) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (سخّر), so it is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first maṣdar.
The clause «الله الذي ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «سخّر ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «تجري ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «تبتغوا ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «لعلّكم تشكرون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī), i.e.: that you may be provided for and that you may give thanks.
The clause «تشكرون» is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of لعلّ.
13- (الواو) conjunction in both places; (لكم) like the first; (ما) a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (في السموات) attached to an omitted ṣila of ما; (ما) like the first and conjoined to it; (في الأرض) like في السموات; (جميعا) a tawkīd (emphasis) in meaning (maʿnawī) of (ما) [Note: Or it is a ḥāl of (ما في السموات وما في الأرض).]; (منه) attached to a ḥāl of ما [Note: It may be a naʿt (adjective) of (جميعا).]; (في ذلك) attached to a fronted khabar of (إنّ); (اللام) for emphasis; (لقوم) attached to a naʿt of (آيات) ...
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآيات ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «سخّر ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the (first) clause سخّر.
The clause «يتفكّرون ...» is in the position of genitive as naʿt of قوم.

safi-cedvel:14-14.t:
* I'rab:
(للذين) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قل); (يغفروا) an imperfect verb, jussive as the answer to the command; the second (للذين) attached to (يغفروا); (لا) negative; (اللام) for giving the reason (taʿlīl); (يجزي) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle. The interpreted maṣdar (أن يجزي..) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to an implied verb, i.e. forgive ... [Note: Or attached to (قل).]
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا..) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (يجزي).
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يغفروا ...» [Translator's note: the source misprints it as «بغفروا».] has no grammatical position: apodosis of an implied condition, not joined with fāʾ, i.e.: if you say to them "forgive", they will forgive ... so the clause that is the object of speech is implied, i.e. "forgive".
The clause «لا يرجون ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يجزي ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «كانوا ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «يكسبون» is in the position of accusative as khabar of كانوا.

* Rhetoric:
Indefiniteness (al-tankīr): in the words of Allah the Exalted «لِيَجْزِيَ قَوْماً بِما كانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ».
What is meant by "a people" is the believers, who are definite (known); the indefiniteness is for praising and extolling them, i.e. they were commanded to do that so that He may recompense on the Day of Resurrection a people — and what a people! — a people singled out for what they earned in this world of good deeds, among which are patience in the face of the harm of the disbelievers, and overlooking them by restraining anger and bearing what is disliked, [with] such immense reward as words fall short of describing.

* Benefits:
- The words of Allah the Exalted: (قُلْ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يَغْفِرُوا لِلَّذِينَ لا يَرْجُونَ أَيَّامَ اللَّهِ), i.e. they do not fear the punitive events of Allah and are heedless of His wrath. Ibn ʿAbbās said: it was revealed concerning ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb; that was because a man of Banū Ghifār insulted him, and ʿUmar was about to strike him, so Allah revealed this verse and commanded him to pardon him. It is also said: it was revealed concerning some of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ from the people of Mecca, who were suffering severe harm from the polytheists before they were commanded to fight; they complained of that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so Allah revealed this verse, and then abrogated it with the verse of fighting.

safi-cedvel:15-15.t:
* I'rab:
(من) a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); (صالحا) an accusative mafʿūl bihi (direct object) [Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, since it is its adjective, i.e. a righteous deed.]; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (لنفسه) khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "عمله"; (الواو) conjunction; (من أساء فعليها) like من عمل.. فلنفسه; (إلى ربّكم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb (ترجعون).
The clause «من عمل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «عمل صالحا ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «(عمله) لنفسه ...» is in the position of jussive as apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), joined with fāʾ.
The clause «من أساء ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause.
The clause «أساء ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the second mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «إساءته عليها» is in the position of jussive as apodosis, joined with fāʾ.
The clause «ترجعون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.

* Benefits:
- In this verse there is evidence for the omission of the mubtadaʾ after the fāʾ of the apodosis, in the words of Allah the Exalted (مَنْ عَمِلَ صالِحاً فَلِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ أَساءَ فَعَلَيْها); the implied forms are (فعمله لنفسه) and (فإساءته عليها).
This discussion has come in detail in Sūrat Fuṣṣilat, verse (49), so go back to it once more.

safi-cedvel:16-20.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath; (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); (الكتاب) an accusative second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الواو) conjunction in all four places; (من الطيّبات) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (رزقناهم); (على العالمين) attached to (فضّلناهم).
The clause «آتينا ...» has no grammatical position: the answer to the implied oath ... the implied oath clause has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «رزقناهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause آتينا.
The clause «فضّلناهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause آتينا.
17- (الواو) conjunction; (من الأمر) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (بيّنات); (الفاء) conjunction; (ما) negative; (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr); (من بعد) attached to (اختلفوا); (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (بغيا) an accusative mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) [Note: Or a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb.]; (بينهم) an accusative adverb (ẓarf), attached to a naʿt of (بغيا). The interpreted maṣdar (ما جاءهم ...) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. The second (بينهم) is attached to (يقضي); (يوم) an accusative adverb of time, attached to (يقضي); (في ما) attached to (يقضي); (فيه) attached to (يختلفون).
The clause «آتيناهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause آتينا.
The clause «اختلفوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause آتينا.
The clause «جاءهم العلم ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «إنّ ربّك يقضي ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يقضي ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The clause «كانوا فيه يختلفون» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «يختلفون» is in the position of accusative as khabar of كانوا.
18- (ثمّ) for conjunction — or resumptive —; (على شريعة) attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi; (من الأمر) attached to a naʿt of (شريعة); (الفاء) conjunctive, linking the cause to the effect; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, making jussive, and the second is negative ...
The clause «جعلناك ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause answering the oath [Note: Or originally resumptive, according to the meaning.].
The clause «اتّبعها ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to a resumption caused by what preceded, i.e.: take heed, and follow it.
The clause «لا تتبع ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause اتّبعها.
The clause «لا يعلمون ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
19- (عنك) attached to (يغنوا) by its being made to carry the meaning of يدفعوا "repel" (taḍmīn); (من الله) attached to a ḥāl of (شيئا) with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. from the punishment of Allah; (الواو) conjunction in both places; (بعضهم) a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is (أولياء).
The clause «إنّهم لن يغنوا ...» has no grammatical position: giving the reason for the preceding prohibition.
The clause «لن يغنوا ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of إنّ.
The clause «إنّ الظالمين ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the causal clause.
The clause «بعضهم أولياء ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the (second) إنّ.
The clause «الله وليّ ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the causal clause.
20- (للناس) attached to a naʿt of (بصائر); (لقوم) attached to (رحمة).
The clause «هذا بصائر ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يوقنون» is in the position of genitive as naʿt of قوم.

* Morphology:
(18) شريعة: a name for the water that people come down to drink; its plural is شرائع. Then it was borrowed for religion.. or it is a name for a doctrine and creed (milla); its pattern is فعيلة with fatḥa then kasra.

safi-cedvel:21-21.t:
* I'rab:
(أم) detached (munqaṭiʿa), meaning بل, together with the hamza of denial. (كالذين) attached to an omitted element, a second direct object (mafʿūl bihi)..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن نجعلهم ... ) is in the position of an accusative, standing in for the two objects of حسب.
(سواء) a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (محياهم), nominative. (ساء) a past verb of censure. (ما) a maṣdar particle.. The specified subject of the censure (al-makhṣūṣ) is implied, i.e. "their judgement".
The interpreted maṣdar (ما يحكمون) is in the position of a nominative, the fāʿil of ساء.
Clause: «حسب الذين ... » has no grammatical position (resumptive). Clause: «اجترحوا ... » has no grammatical position (ṣila of the relative noun (الذين)). Clause: «نجعلهم ... » has no grammatical position (ṣila of the particle (أن)). Clause: «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position (ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين)). Clause: «عملوا ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause آمنوا). Clause: «سواء محياهم ... » is in the position of an accusative, a badal (substitute) for the implied second object [Note: The meaning of the verse: Did they think that We would make them in the Hereafter as happy as the believers, equal to their life in this world.. It is also permissible that the clause be an explanatory resumptive clause with no grammatical position.]. Clause: «ساء ما يحكمون ... » has no grammatical position (resumptive). Clause: «يحكمون» has no grammatical position (ṣila of the particle (ما)).

safi-cedvel:22-22.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; the second and third are conjunctions, and the last is a ḥāl (circumstantial) wāw. (بالحقّ) attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil of خلق or of its object. (اللام) of purpose. (كلّ) the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative. (ما) a maṣdar particle ... [Note: Or a relative noun in the position of a genitive, with the returning pronoun omitted, and the clause after it is its ṣila.], (لا) negative. The interpreted maṣdar (ما كسبت ... ) is in the position of a genitive by the bā᾽, attached to (تجزى). The interpreted maṣdar (أن تجزي) is in the position of a genitive by the lām, attached to (خلق), conjoined to an implied purpose ... i.e. "He created the heavens and the earth so that they point to His power and so that every soul be recompensed ...".
Clause: «خلق الله ... » has no grammatical position (resumptive). Clause: «تجزى كلّ نفس ... » has no grammatical position (ṣila of the implied particle (أن)). Clause: «كسبت ... » has no grammatical position (ṣila of the particle (ما)). Clause: «هم لا يظلمون» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl. Clause: «لا يظلمون» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).

safi-cedvel:23-23.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) of interrogation conveying a request. (الفاء) resumptive. (أرأيت) meaning "tell me". (من) a relative noun in the position of an accusative, a first direct object. (هواه) a direct object whose governor is اتّخذ. (على علم) a ḥāl from the fāʿil or from the object. (الواو) conjunction in the three places. (على سمعه) attached to (ختم). (على بصره) attached to an omitted element, a second direct object whose governor is جعل. (الفاء) redundant, for linking, because of the length of the discourse. (من) an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause يهديه. (الهمزة) of interrogation expressing rebuke. (الفاء) conjunction. (لا) negative. (تذكّرون) an imperfect verb, nominative, from which one of the two tāʾs has been omitted.
Clause: «رأيت ... » has no grammatical position (resumptive). Clause: «اتّخذ ... » has no grammatical position (ṣila of the relative noun (من)). Clause: «أضلّه الله ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the ṣila clause). Clause: «ختم ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the ṣila clause). Clause: «جعل ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the ṣila clause). Clause: «من يهديه ... » is in the position of an accusative, a second direct object of the verb رأيت. Clause: «يهديه ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من). Clause: «تذكّرون» has no grammatical position (conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, i.e. "Were you heedless, so that you do not take heed?").

* Rhetoric:
The inverted simile (al-tashbīh al-maqlūb): in His saying, the Exalted, «أَفَرَأَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلهَهُ هَواهُ».
The saying اتخذ إلهه هواه is put in place of "هواه إلهه"; so he has made his desire his object of worship, to which he submits and which he obeys, as the worshipper submits to the one he worships.

safi-cedvel:24-25.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (ما) negative, non-operative. (هي) the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), a mubtadaʾ in the position of a nominative. (إلّا) for restriction. (الدنيا) an adjective (naʿt) of the khabar. (حياتنا) nominative. (الواو) conjunction in both places, and the third is a ḥāl (circumstantial) wāw. (ما) negative in both places. (لهم) attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (علم), which is genitive in form, nominative in position. (إن) a particle of negation. (إلّا) for restriction..
Clause: «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position (resumptive). Clause: «ما هي إلّا حياتنا ... » is in the position of an accusative, the quoted speech (maqūl al-qawl). Clause: «نموت ... » has no grammatical position (an explanatory resumptive clause). Clause: «نحيا ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause نموت). Clause: «ما يهلكنا إلّا الدهر ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause نموت). Clause: «ما لهم ... من علم» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from the fāʿil of قالوا. Clause: «إن هم إلّا يظنّون» is in the position of an accusative, a badal (substitute) for the clause ما لهم.. من علم [Note: Or it has no grammatical position, giving a reason.]. Clause: «يظنّون» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).
25- (الواو) conjunction. (عليهم) attached to (تتلى). (آياتنا) the nāʾib fāʿil, nominative. (بيّنات) an accusative ḥāl from آياتنا. (ما) negative. (حجّتهم) the khabar of كان. (أن) a maṣdar particle. (بآبائنا) attached to (ائتوا). (كنتم) an incomplete past verb (kāna) in the position of a jussive, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
Clause: «تتلى ... » is in the position of a genitive, a muḍāf ilayhi. Clause: «ما كان حجّتهم ... » has no grammatical position (apodosis of a non-jussive condition) [Note: It is possible that the apodosis is omitted, i.e. "they disbelieved ...", and that the clause: ما كان حجّتهم ... is a reason.]. Clause: «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position (ṣila of the particle (أن)); and the interpreted maṣdar (أن قالوا ... ) is in the position of a nominative, the ism of كان. Clause: «ائتوا ... » is in the position of an accusative, the quoted speech. Clause: «كنتم صادقين» has no grammatical position (resumptive) ... and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by what precedes it ... i.e. "if you are truthful in what is said about the resurrection, then bring our fathers ...".

* Benefits:
1- The Dahrīs (al-Dahriyyūn)..
This verse set out some of the doctrines of disbelief, namely that of the Dahrīs (the Materialists), who believe in the eternity of the world, deny the resurrection and life after death, and acknowledge no life other than the life of this world; in it they live and in it they die, and nothing destroys them except time (al-dahr), that is, the succession of night and day. The falsehood and fabrication in this doctrine are evident, for Allah, who created man when he was nothing worth mentioning, is able to bring him back a second time. On another side, it is not permissible in the Sharia to curse or revile time (al-dahr),
for it is reported in the sound ḥadīth narrated by al-Bukhārī and Muslim:
On the authority of Abū Hurayra, may Allah be pleased with him, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Allah the Mighty and Majestic said: "The son of Adam harms Me by reviling time, while I am time; in My hand is the command; I alternate the night and the day." In another narration: "The son of Adam harms Me, and says: 'O the failure of time!' So let none of you say: 'O the failure of time!', for I am time; I alternate its night and its day, and when I wish, I take them both." In another narration: "The son of Adam reviles time, while I am time; in My hand are the night and the day."
The meaning of these ḥadīths is that it was the habit of the Arabs to blame time and revile it in times of calamity, because they used to attribute to time the misfortunes and hardships that befell them, saying:
"The blows of time struck them", and "Time destroyed them", as Allah the Mighty and Majestic informed about them in His saying: (وما يهلكنا إلا الدهر). When they ascribed to time the hardships that befell them and reviled the doer of them, their reviling returned to Allah the Exalted, since He is in truth the doer of the things they ascribe to time; so they were forbidden to revile time. And it was said to them: Do not revile the doer of that, for He is Allah the Mighty and Majestic.
2- The sound feminine plural (jamʿ al-muʾannath al-sālim)..
In this verse occurs the word (آياتنا), which is a sound feminine plural (آية، آيات). In what follows we shall explain what relates to this plural. The general rule for forming the sound feminine plural of a noun: you add alif and tāʾ to it without any change in it, so you say: هند: هندات. Excepted from this:
1- What ends in tāʾ of feminine gender: the tāʾ is dropped, so you say of فاطمة: فاطمات.
2- The maqṣūr noun (ending in alif maqṣūra): if its alif is the third letter, it is returned to its origin, as in: عصا: عصوات, هدى: هديات. If it is the fourth letter or beyond, it is turned into yāʾ: حبلى: حبليات, مستشفى: مستشفيات.
3- The mamdūd noun (ending in a long alif followed by hamza): if its hamza is for feminine gender, it is turned into wāw: سمراء: سمراوات. If its hamza is converted from a root letter, it may be kept or turned into wāw: (رجاء), the name of a female, whose plural we say: رجاءات or رجاوات.
3- And what is like دعد and سجدة: its middle radical (ʿayn) takes fatḥa, so you say: دعدات - سجدات.
This rule applies to every triliteral noun with a sound middle radical whose middle radical is sukūn. As for ضخمة, زينب, جوزة and شجرة, the middle radical stays as it is. As for words such as خطوة and هند, the fatḥa is not obligatory; rather both sukūn and fatḥa are permitted. This plural is regular only in: 1- Names of females: such as مريم - زينب - سعاد - هند.
2- What ends in tāʾ: حمزة - جميلة - حسنة.
3- What ends in the short feminine alif, like (حبلى), or the long one, like (سمراء).
4- The diminutive of a non-rational noun: دريهم - جبيل.
5- The adjective of a non-rational noun: شامخ, an adjective of a mountain.
6- Every quinqueliteral noun for which no broken plural has been heard, like (سرادق) and (حمّام); and (أولات) and what is used as a name, like (عرفات), are attached to the sound feminine plural in its i'rab.
The sound feminine plural is nominative with ḍamma, and is accusative and genitive with kasra.

safi-cedvel:26-26.t:
* I'rab:
(ثمّ) a conjunction in both places. (إلى يوم) attached to (يجمعكم), by its being given the sense of "leads you" or "transfers you". (لا) the lā of generic negation. (فيه) attached to the khabar of lā. (الواو) conjunction. (لا) negative ...
Clause: «قل ... » has no grammatical position (an explanatory resumptive clause).
Clause: «الله يحييكم ... » is in the position of an accusative, the quoted speech. Clause: «يحييكم ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله). Clause: «يميتكم ... » is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause يحييكم. Clause: «يجمعكم ... » is in the position of a nominative, a khabar, conjoined to the clause يميتكم. Clause: «لا ريب فيه» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from يوم القيامة. Clause: «لكنّ أكثر ... » is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause of the quoted speech. Clause: «لا يعلمون» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of لكنّ.

safi-cedvel:27-35.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (لله) attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ملك). (الواو) conjunction in both places. (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يخسر). (يومئذ) an adverb annexed to an adverb, a badal (substitute) for the first يوم, or an emphasis (tawkīd) of it [Note: It is permissible that (يومئذ) be attached to (يخسر), and (يوم) be attached to an omitted element, its implied form being "the reckoning takes place", or "the people are gathered" ...].
Clause: «لله ملك ... » has no grammatical position (resumptive). Clause: «تقوم الساعة ... » is in the position of a genitive, a muḍāf ilayhi. Clause: «يخسر المبطلون ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the resumptive clause).
28- (الواو) conjunction. (جاثية) a ḥāl from كلّ أمّة [Note: Or an adjective (naʿt), because the annexation of كلّ to أمّة did not make it more definite.], accusative; and the nāʾib fāʿil of the verb (تدعى) is a latent pronoun referring to the second كلّ أمّة. (إلى كتابها) attached to (تدعى). (اليوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to the passive (تجزون), and the wāw is the pronoun of the nāʾib fāʿil. (ما) a relative in the position of an accusative, a direct object, with the returning pronoun omitted..
Clause: «ترى ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause يخسر المبطلون). Clause: «كلّ أمّة تدعى ... » has no grammatical position (resumptive). Clause: «تدعى ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (كلّ أمّة). Clause: «تجزون ... » is in the position of an accusative, the quoted speech of an implied saying. Clause: «كنتم تعملون» has no grammatical position (ṣila of the relative (ما)). Clause: «تعملون» is in the position of an accusative, the khabar of كنتم.
29- (عليكم) attached to (ينطق), by its being given the sense of "testifies". (بالحقّ) attached to a ḥāl from the fāʿil of ينطق. (ما) a relative in the position of an accusative, with the returning pronoun omitted. Clause: «هذا كتابنا ... » has no grammatical position (a resumptive within the scope of the saying). Clause: «ينطق ... » is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from كتابنا [Note: Or it is a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ هذا.. It is also permissible that it be the khabar, with (كتابنا) a badal from the demonstrative ذا.]. Clause: «إنّا كنّا ... » has no grammatical position (giving a reason).
Clause: «كنّا نستنسخ ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ. Clause: «نستنسخ ... » is in the position of an accusative, the khabar of كنّا. Clause: «كنتم تعملون» has no grammatical position (ṣila of the relative (ما)). Clause: «تعملون» is in the position of an accusative, the khabar of كنتم.
30- (الفاء) a conjunction of consequence (tafrīʿ). (أمّا) a particle of condition and elaboration. (الفاء) the second, linking the apodosis of أمّا. (في رحمته) attached to the verb (يدخلهم). (هو) a separation pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) ...
Clause: «الذين آمنوا ... فيدخلهم» has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause هذا كتابنا). Clause: «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position (ṣila of the relative (الذين)). Clause: «عملوا ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause آمنوا). Clause: «يدخلهم ربّهم ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين). Clause: «ذلك ... الفوز» has no grammatical position (parenthetical).
31- (الواو) conjunction. (أمّا الذين كفروا) like أمّا الذين آمنوا, and the khabar is implied, i.e. "Allah says to them". (الهمزة) of interrogation expressing rebuke. (الفاء) conjunction; and the nāʾib fāʿil of the passive is a latent pronoun referring to آياتي. (عليكم) attached to (تتلى). (الفاء) conjunction, and likewise the wāw ...
Clause: «الذين كفروا ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause الذين آمنوا). Clause: «لم تكن آياتي ... » is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to an implied clause of the quoted speech, i.e. "Did My messengers not come to you, and were My verses not recited to you ...".
Clause: «تتلى عليكم ... » is in the position of an accusative, the khabar of تكن. Clause: «استكبرتم» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause لم تكن آياتي..
Clause: «كنتم قوما ... » is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause استكبرتم.
32- (الواو) conjunction in both places. (لا) the lā of generic negation. (فيها) attached to the khabar of lā. (ما) the first is negative and the second is interrogative, a mubtadaʾ. (الساعة) the khabar, nominative. (إن) a particle of negation. (إلّا) for restriction. (ظنّا) an absolute object (mafʿūl muṭlaq), accusative, and the two objects of نظنّ are implied, i.e. "we do not think the resurrection to be something that will occur". (الواو) conjunction. (ما) negative, operating like ليس. (مستيقنين) genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of ما. Clause: «قيل ... » is in the position of a genitive, a muḍāf ilayhi. Clause: «إنّ وعد الله حقّ» is in the position of a nominative, the nāʾib fāʿil - it is originally the quoted speech. Clause: «الساعة لا ريب فيها» is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause of the nāʾib fāʿil. Clause: «لا ريب فيها» is in the position of the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الساعة). Clause: «قلتم» has no grammatical position (apodosis of a non-jussive condition). Clause: «ما ندري ... » is in the position of an accusative, the quoted speech. Clause: «ما الساعة» is in the position of an accusative, standing in for the two objects of ندري, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by (ما). Clause: «إن نظن إلّا ظنّا» has no grammatical position (a resumptive within the scope of the saying) [Note: It was said that the clause is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being نحن, and that (إلّا) is postponed, i.e. "إن نحن إلّا نظنّ ظنّا" ... Abū al-Baqāʾ permitted the above i'rab on the assumption that الظنّ means knowledge and doubt, i.e. "we hold no belief except doubt"]. Clause: «ما نحن بمستيقنين» has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause إن نظنّ).
33- (الواو) conjunction in both places. (لهم) attached to (بدا). (ما) a maṣdar particle, and the second is a relative noun in the position of a nominative, the fāʿil of (حاق). (بهم) attached to (حاق). (به) attached to (يستهزئون). The interpreted maṣdar (ما عملوا) is in the position of a genitive, a muḍāf ilayhi. Clause: «بدا لهم سيّئات ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause أمّا الذين كفروا ...).
Clause: «عملوا ... » has no grammatical position (ṣila of the particle (ما)). Clause: «حاق بهم ما كانوا ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause بدا لهم سيّئات). Clause: «كانوا به يستهزئون» has no grammatical position (ṣila of the relative (ما)). Clause: «يستهزئون» is in the position of an accusative, the khabar of كانوا [Note: In the Qur'an copies printed in Syria, the twenty-fifth juzʾ ends at this verse.. As for the copies printed in Egypt, the juzʾ ends in them at the end of the sūra, and we have preferred this Egyptian edition.]
34- (الواو) conjunction. (اليوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (ننساكم). (ما) a maṣdar particle. (هذا) a demonstrative, an adjective of يومكم, in the position of a genitive. (الواو) conjunction in both places. (ما) negative. (لكم) attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ناصرين. (ناصرين) genitive in form, nominative in position. Clause: «قيل ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause حاق ...).
Clause: «ننساكم ... » is in the position of a nominative, the nāʾib fāʿil. Clause: «نسيتم ... » has no grammatical position (ṣila of the particle (ما)). The interpreted maṣdar (ما نسيتم) is in the position of a genitive by the kāf, attached to an omitted absolute object, i.e. "a forgetting like your forgetting the meeting". Clause: «مأواكم النار ... » is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause ننساكم. Clause: «ما لكم من ناصرين ... » is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause ننساكم.
35- (ذلكم) a mubtadaʾ. (هزوا) a second direct object, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّكم اتّخذتم ... ) is in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ, attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ذلكم).
(الفاء) resumptive. (اليوم) an adverb, accusative, attached to (يخرجون). (لا) negative. (منها) attached to the negated (يخرجون). (الواو) conjunction. (لا) negative, and the wāw in (يخرجون، يستعتبون) is the nāʾib fāʿil in each of them. Clause: «ذلكم بأنّكم اتّخذتم ... » has no grammatical position (giving a reason). Clause: «اتّخذتم ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of أنّ. Clause: «غرّتكم الحياة ... » is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause اتّخذتم. Clause: «لا يخرجون منها ... » has no grammatical position (resumptive). Clause: «لا هم يستعتبون ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the resumptive clause). Clause: «يستعتبون» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).

* Morphology:
(28) جاثية: the feminine of جاث, an active participle from the triliteral جثا يجثو, meaning "knelt", of the chapter of نصر; its pattern is فاعٍ and the feminine is فاعلة. In جاثية there is a weakening by substitution (iʿlāl bi-l-qalb), because its origin is جاثوة: the letter before the wāw came to have kasra, so it was turned into yāʾ.
(32) مستيقنين: the plural of مستيقن, an active participle from the sextiliteral (augmented) verb استيقن; its pattern is مستفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
1- The implicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-makniyya): in His saying, the Exalted, «هذا كِتابُنا يَنْطِقُ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ».
Here the Book is likened to a witness who gives his testimony and bears witness to the truth. The thing likened to (al-mushabbah bihi) is omitted and one of its concomitants is borrowed for it, namely speaking in testimony.
2- The loose figurative expression (al-majāz al-mursal): in His saying, the Exalted, «فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ». A person cannot dwell in mercy, because it is one of the abstract meanings; what dwells in its place, the place of mercy, is Paradise, i.e. "He will admit them into His Paradise". So the use of "mercy" for its place is a figure in which the thing placed is mentioned and the place is meant, and its relation is that of locality.
3- The loose figurative expression: in His saying, the Exalted, «وَقِيلَ الْيَوْمَ نَنْساكُمْ».
Forgetting is the cause of abandoning; if one forgets something, he has abandoned it and neglected it entirely. So the relation of this figure is causality.
4- The shift (al-iltifāt): in His saying, the Exalted, «فَالْيَوْمَ لا يُخْرَجُونَ مِنْها».
Here there is a shift from address to the third person, to signal that they have been dropped from the rank of being addressed, in contempt of them, or by moving them from the station of address into the depths of the Fire.

* Benefits:
1- Your deeds are recorded against you..
This verse indicates that the deed of the son of Adam is recorded against him, in His saying, the Exalted, إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنْسِخُ ما كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ. There is no deed a person does or word he says but it is recorded against him and stored in a book which he will meet on the Day of Resurrection. Many verses combine to establish this; the Exalted said: ما يَلْفِظُ مِنْ قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ and the Exalted said وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحافِظِينَ. كِراماً كاتِبِينَ. يَعْلَمُونَ ما تَفْعَلُونَ. As for storing them in a book, the Exalted said وَكُلَّ إِنسانٍ أَلْزَمْناهُ طائِرَهُ فِي عُنُقِهِ وَنُخْرِجُ لَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيامَةِ كِتاباً يَلْقاهُ مَنْشُوراً.
And the Exalted said: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ فَيَقُولُ هاؤُمُ اقْرَؤُا كِتابِيَهْ. And these deeds are raised to Allah on Monday and Thursday, by the evidence that he, upon him be peace and blessings, was asked about the reason for his fasting on Monday and Thursday, and he said: "On them a person's deeds are raised, and I like my deeds to be raised while I am fasting."
2- Resolving a difficulty..
In this verse occurs His saying, the Exalted: إِنْ نَظُنُّ إِلَّا ظَنًّا. The grammarians said that the complete exception (al-istithnāʾ al-mufarragh) does not occur with the emphatic absolute object, for there is no benefit in it. It was answered that the maṣdar in the verse is one of kind, with the adjective omitted, i.e. "we think only a weak thought". But the majority of grammarians interpreted the verse as meaning: "إن نحن إلا نظن ظنا". And it was said: it is in its place, because نظن may mean knowledge and doubt, so doubt is excepted: i.e. "we hold no belief except doubt".
Imam al-Nasafī gave a brief statement on this point which was eloquent and satisfying, saying:
(إن نظن إلا ظنا): its origin is نظن ظنا, and its meaning is solely the affirmation of thinking; so the particle of negation and exception were introduced to convey the affirmation of thinking together with the denial of everything else, and the denial of everything other than thinking was strengthened by His saying, the Exalted, after that: (وَما نَحْنُ بِمُسْتَيْقِنِينَ). In any case the speech of Allah the Mighty and Majestic remains greater than being confined in the moulds of the grammatical rules, and too exalted for us always to subject it to the laws of grammar; it is the origin and whatever else is a branch, it is the judge and whatever else follows it; it is exalted and nothing is exalted above it.

safi-cedvel:36-37.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive. (لله) attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الحمد). (ربّ) a badal (substitute) for the word of majesty in the three places, or an adjective of it, genitive ...
Clause: «لله الحمد ... » has no grammatical position (resumptive).
37- (الواو) conjunction. (له الكبرياء) like لله الحمد. (في السموات) attached to (الكبرياء) [Note: Or attached to the omitted khabar.. or attached to a ḥāl from الكبرياء, the governor in it being the notion of settledness (istiqrār).]. (الواو) conjunction in both places. (الحكيم) a second khabar, nominative ...
Clause: «له الكبرياء ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the resumptive clause). Clause: «هو العزيز ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the resumptive clause).
